text:
Anya: Quick sync — Helios insurance POC readout Wed 4/20 09:00 PT. Need final KPIs (latency, accuracy on claims classification eval, cost/run), unresolved security questions, and the expansion ask. Can each owner drop items here by EOD today?

Matt: Got the final evals, uploading short summary below.

Matt: ```KPIs
p50 latency: 120ms
p95 latency: 320ms
avg tokens/request: 450
accuracy (claims classifier): 92.1% (eval set A)
false-positive rate: 3.8%
request success rate: 99.7%
approx cost: $0.034 per 1k tokens
```

Sandeep: Quick pricing question — Helios asked for committed monthly capacity + overage structure. Proposal: Dedicated entry plan (committed) + 20% discounted overage. @Anya can you confirm target ARR ask so I can build numbers?

Anya: Target expansion ask = commit -> Dedicated monthly $25k MRC + $15k one-time integration professional services. Keep that as the baseline ask for the readout.

Elaine: Security blockers to surface: SOC2 report, VPC peering (no public egress during pilot), and data residency for EU. SOC2 doc is in the drive, VPC peering requires network team (ETA ~2w).

Matt: Action item: I'll make a 2-slide tech readout: 1) final metrics + prompt-eval summary, 2) gaps & mitigations. I'll drop slides here by 18:00.

Sandeep: Contract notes: start with 90-day pilot -> automatic conversion to MRC unless terminated. Also request fallback clause to smaller model on failure. Legal flagged data residency — @Elaine can you confirm EU-only production support?

Elaine: Confirmed — we can support EU-only region for production. Pilot can run US-hosted. Adding data residency note to readout.

Anya: Please make sure slides include success criteria:
1) >= 90% classification accuracy on eval set
2) p95 latency < 500ms
3) cost < $0.05 per 1k tokens
4) reduction in manual triage volume >= 40%
Flag anything that doesn't meet these.

Matt: Prompt eval highlights: 120 curated prompts, 5.2% failure rate. Top failure modes: hallucination on edge-case policy codes, truncation on very long notes. Will attach sample prompts + mitigations.

Sandeep: I'll prepare the commercial appendix (pricing ladder, T&Cs, expansion path) and the next-steps slide. Will call out sales motion and enablement runbook.

Anya: Who presents on the call? Proposal: Matt (tech deep dive), Sandeep (commercial & pricing), Anya (exec summary). Confirm by EOD.

Matt: Confirmed :thumbsup:

Elaine: Confirmed. Pinging network infra for peering task. /cc InfraBot

DeployBot: Reminder: POC autoscale logs uploaded -> https://files.redwood/helios/poc/logs

Anya: Thanks team — I'll collate slides, finalize the one-pager and send invites + final materials by 17:30.
